trajectory_summary: The call opens cooperatively, dips into cost skepticism twice, and ends on warm but structurally empty ground — no appointment time, no locked callback, just a vague 'I'll hear from you Monday.' Energy technically improved by the end (customer thanks rep by name) but nothing concrete was built to capture that goodwill into pipeline.
outcome_dispute: This should not be read as any flavor of booked/tentative appointment — the rep never proposed a closer appointment at all, only a bill-photo follow-up. It is a callback dependent on the customer initiating contact, which is weaker than a rep-owned callback.
